BLOCK 1 — PASTE INTO SUNO: STYLE

melodic techno, 124 BPM, A minor, euphoric lift, rolling bass, airy pads, wide hats, female vocal, stereo chorus

BLOCK 2 — PASTE INTO SUNO: LYRICS

[Instrumental Intro]

[Verse 1]
[Female Vocalist] [Soft] [Stripped Back]
Wait for the light to break the floor
Hands on the rail we’re counting four

[Chorus]

Higher we go
We lose control

[End]
